text:
sasha: quick follow-up from the RFC rollforward — we saw a small-prompt accuracy dip (~3-4% EM) when enabling per-head FP8 for the 'base-13b' flavor on staging.
kevin: ugh. is that on short completion tasks only or across the board?
sasha: mostly when prompt+response <= 64 tokens. longform seems fine. looks like headwise scaling interacted with LN residuals.
neha: can you paste the short repro?
sasha: repro is a 1k prompt suite (internal), run A: fp32 baseline, B: headwise-fp8. delta appears in QA-style exact-match.
dmitri: interesting — could be quant scale collision on early layers. do we have per-layer hist stats?
sasha: yes, attached snapshot in thread (summary): early-attn scales had higher stddev after calibration.
kevin: hypothesis: calibration procedure optimizes for avg token distribution, but short prompts are sensitive to prefix activations that aren't in the calibration set.
neha: makes sense. short-context has different activation distribution — we should avoid overfitting calibrator to random long examples.
dmitri: possible mitigations: 1) keep per-head FP8 but add "prefix-bias" table for first N tokens, 2) fallback to INT8 for seq_len <= 64, 3) per-customer override in precision profile.
sasha: ops ask: what's least invasive to ship quickly?
neha: fallback to INT8 for short sequences is simplest: one runtime check on request length before choosing kernel. low-risk but loses some perf for tiny requests.
kevin: alternative: apply a light prefix re-calibration pass — compute per-head affine bias for tokens 0..T during serve (cheap). That might recover accuracy with <5% perf hit.
dmitri: re-calib-on-serve feels risky to put into hot path. we could do an offline micro-calib step per model variant and store a small table in the precision profile: e.g., prefix_table: {"len32": {head0: scale,bias ...}}
neha: that's nice: keeps runtime simple, adds a small metadata blob to profiles. profile API change needed.
sasha: can you sketch the profile change?
neha: quick example config snippet: ```json
{
  "precision": "fp8-headwise",
  "calibration": "global_v2",
  "short_ctx_patches": {
    "<=64": "prefix_table_v1",
    "<=32": "prefix_table_v2"
  }
}
```
kevin: runtime usage: on request, pick most specific patch key for seq_len and apply per-head scale+bias before token forward. trivial vector add/mul.
dmitri: also add a checksum for the prefix_table so ops can validate profile/serving parity.
sasha: ops-bot: any concerns for Dedicated/Private users with profile blobs?
ops-bot: @sasha noted. key concerns: profile blob size (keep < 64KB), backward compatibility for older runtimes, and migration plan for existing profiles. Recommend feature-flag rollout. :white_check_mark:
neha: rollout plan proposal: 1) spec PR for profile schema, 2) implement loader + checksum in runtime, 3) generate prefix_table offline for top 10 models, 4) shadow serve on staging, 5) canary 1% hosted traffic with fallback enabled.
kevin: metrics to monitor: EM/ROUGE on short prompt slices, latency P95, extra memory for prefix tables, and error rates for profile mismatches.
dmitri: ops playbook snippet for oncall: ```
# when short-prompt regression spikes
1) set env PRECISION_SHORT_FALLBACK=INT8
2) rollback profile to previous tag
3) run quick diff of prefix_table checksums
4) escalate to eng-ml with repro id
```
sasha: sounds actionable. timeline? can we do a pilot this week for the top two models?
neha: I'll carve out time for calibration generator and a small PR tomorrow. dmitri, can you add schema PR?
dmitri: will do. tagging @kevin for review once I have a sketch.
kevin: I'll prepare the staging shadow test harness and add the short-prompt suite.
sasha: thanks all. final decision: implement prefix_table in profile + short-seq fallback guard as safety net. roll forward with feature flag and canary.
neha: noted. will attach generator metrics and size estimate to the PR.
kevin: one last note — add opt-out flag on customer precision profiles because some enterprise customers prefer consistent perf over micro-accuracy diffs.
dmitri: added to spec.
ops-bot: plan logged: https://redwood.internal/ops/issue/QUANT-INC-214 — watchers: eng-ml, eng-runtime, customer-ops
sasha: closing loop — I'll post RFC follow-up with links to PRs and canary ticket. :rocket:
